items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: >> [(prose)] We opened a place out on Highland for this fella that -- guy by the name of Art Wizzen (PHONETIC), that owned the -- a whole string of things called the Chili Bowls out here, years ago. [(note)] Oh yeah, I remember them.

ctx.x: big band arrangements. We'd play everything that Jimmie Lunceford ever played and we'd play everything that Duke ever played or anybody that ever made anything good and on top of that, we had things that we did that nobody else did. Like we had parodies on "Poor Butterfly," like we had called it "The Big Pat Butterfly," you know, and we'd sing it with little commutations [sic] "That commutations like that. A Chick was high, like a big fat butterfly," and things, you know, and a real fun band and we were the…
